_comment: Training set for the Q1 'language of thought' probe (obench-interp train-probes). Short, everyday sentences and questions, ~20 per language, label = language code. Captured at the last token with NO chat template (we want the last content token). The probe is multiclass logistic regression on the standardized residual stream, per layer. Expand per language as needed; language is highly linearly separable so this is enough to start.
